name: Liberty Agile Retirement Annuity 2
description: Tax-efficient retirement savings product with portfolio choice and potential contribution deductions.
spec_notes: Locked in under retirement-fund rules until retirement, ordinarily from age 55. Minimum shown by Liberty: R15,000 lump sum or R500 monthly.

name: Liberty Evolve Retirement Annuity
description: Retirement annuity within the Evolve investment range, combining retirement saving with the Evolve investment proposition.
spec_notes: Current Liberty retirement page lists this product, but product-specific minimums and fees should be confirmed from the latest quotation or product specification.

name: Evolve Investment Plan
description: Pay-on-delivery endowment investment using the Capped Tracker proposition and a choice of additional portfolios.
spec_notes: Minimum initial investment stated by Liberty is R150,000. Endowment restrictions apply for the first five years.

name: Liberty Excelsior 600 Capital Bond Endowment
description: Goal-based regular-premium investment plan with terms of 5, 10 or 15 years and a capital-protection feature subject to product terms.
spec_notes: Published minimum monthly amounts: R500 over 5 years, R300 over 10 years or R200 over 15 years. The table records the overall minimum of R200; actual minimum depends on selected term.

name: STASH by Liberty
description: App-based tax-free investment that allows clients to invest small amounts into an SA Top 40 Shares portfolio, a Cash+ portfolio, or both, with access to funds through the app.
spec_notes: No formal minimum investment. Automatic daily contributions can start from R5 per day, and clients can also make manual contributions. Tax-free savings contribution limits apply. Portfolio values can fluctuate where invested in the SA Top 40 Shares portfolio.

name: Liberty Offshore Investment Plan
description: Offshore endowment investment providing access to international markets, currencies and global investment portfolios within a South African policy wrapper.
spec_notes: The product is structured as an endowment and is therefore subject to five-year restriction-period rules. Investment currencies, minimums, fees, tax treatment and available portfolios should be confirmed from the latest quotation and product specification.

name: INN8 Endowment
description: INN8-administered endowment wrapper designed for tax-managed wealth accumulation and estate-planning applications.
spec_notes: Endowment restriction-period rules apply. Ownership options, tax treatment, minimums, fees and access rules should be confirmed from the latest product terms.

name: INN8 Retirement Annuity
description: INN8-administered retirement annuity for tax-efficient retirement saving with access to an adviser-selected investment range.
spec_notes: Contributions, access and investment limits are governed by retirement-fund and Regulation 28 requirements. Confirm minimums and fees from current INN8 terms.

name: INN8 Offshore Investment Account
description: INN8-administered offshore investment account providing multi-currency access to international funds and model portfolios.
spec_notes: Foreign-exchange allowances, tax clearance requirements, currencies, minimums, fees and investment options should be confirmed from the current offshore account terms.
